analysis:
The only change is in docs/reference/configuration.md at line 594 on both the base and head sides. It is a documentation-only addition to the MLX_QUANTIZED_CONSTANT_CACHE row. The new text states that bf16 GPT-OSS checkpoints keep bf16 activations, so the BF16-to-FP32 constant cache does not apply to them.

This is a performance note. It changes no environment variables, defaults, or LaunchAgent passthrough. It also leaves prefix-cache gates (T-041/SEC-035), attestation, encryption, authorization, and the wire contract (TB-002, TB-007, TB-011) untouched.

The surrounding text in head lines 1-311 and base lines 487-597 is unchanged in this hunk and was reviewed only for context. The SSD cache TTL, encryption, and KEK wording are consistent with T-041.

The claim at line 594 that the cache is not applicable to bf16 checkpoints could only affect correctness or performance, not the security posture. Model output integrity remains covered by T-007, T-027 and T-056.

No regression was found and no threat-model update is needed. Code behavior in libs/mlx-swift ConstantArrayCastCache was not supplied and was not verified, but it is not security-relevant here.
